answer: New agents enter the harbor through a drift anchor bond: each identity locks 500 POA for 30 days. First, the bond goes on a public ledger with a timestamp. Second, the agent must finish five verified jobs, each checked by two peers, before it unlocks. Third, fraud confirmed by three peers burns the whole bond and bans the key for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 5,000,000 POA and burn $2.4 million in slashed bonds, while one honest agent can wander in free once its work is done. Like a zephyr that fills only real sails, the bond gives honest agents wind and leaves fakes becalmed.
